readmeHtml:
项目的由来

虽然国内教育网站已提供免费资源，但大多数普通人获取信息的途径依然受限。有些人利用这一点，在某站上销售这些带有私人水印的资源。为了应对这种情况，我计划将这些资源集中并开源，以促进义务教育的普及和消除地区间的教育贫困。

还有一个最重要的原因是，希望海外华人能够让自己的孩子继续了解国内教育。

学习数学

希望未来出现更多不是为了考学而读书的人。

问题：如何合并被拆分的文件？

由于 GitHub 对单个文件的上传有最大限制，超过 100MB 的文件会被拒绝上传，超过 50MB 的文件上传时会收到警告。因此，文件大小超过 50MB 的文件会被拆分成每个 35MB 的多个文件。

示例

文件被拆分的示例：

  • 义务教育教科书 · 数学一年级上册.pdf.1
  • 义务教育教科书 · 数学一年级上册.pdf.2

解决办法

要合并这些被拆分的文件，您只需执行以下步骤(其他操作系统同理)：

  1. 将合并程序 mergePDFs-windows-amd64.exe 下载到包含 PDF 文件的文件夹中。
  2. 确保 mergePDFs-windows-amd64.exe 和被拆分的 PDF 文件在同一目录下。
  3. 双击 mergePDFs-windows-amd64.exe 程序即可自动完成文件合并。

下载方式

您可以通过以下链接，下载文件合并程序：

下载文件合并程序

文件和程序示例

  • mergePDFs-windows-amd64.exe
  • 义务教育教科书 · 数学一年级上册.pdf.1
  • 义务教育教科书 · 数学一年级上册.pdf.2

重新下载

  • 如果您位于内地，并且网络不错，想重新下载，您可以使用 tchMaterial-parser 项目（鼓励开源），进行重新下载。
  • 如果您位于国外，和内地网络通信速度较慢，建议使用本存储库进行签出。

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source collection of Chinese educational textbooks to promote equal access to education.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This project centralizes and open-sources digital copies of standard Chinese educational textbooks. It aims to eliminate educational poverty by providing free, unrestricted access to materials that are often paywalled or watermarked on other sites. The repository organizes resources by subject and grade level, focusing heavily on mathematics for primary education. It provides direct download links to PDF versions of the textbooks. The initiative is particularly aimed at helping overseas Chinese families maintain access to domestic educational standards.
keyFeatures: Centralized Repository: Aggregates scattered educational resources into one accessible location.
Watermark-free Content: Provides clean versions of textbooks unlike commercial alternatives.
Structured Organization: Sorts materials logically by grade level and academic subject.
Direct PDF Access: Offers simple, straightforward links to download the textbook files.
Open Source Ethos: Promotes the free sharing of knowledge to combat educational inequality.

useCases.description: Expatriate families use the materials to teach their children Chinese educational standards at home.

useCases.title: Rural Access
useCases.description: Educators in underfunded areas download free resources to supplement their teaching materials.

useCases.title: Self Study
useCases.description: Students independently access textbooks to study ahead or review complex mathematical concepts.

useCases.title: Resource Archiving
useCases.description: Researchers and archivists preserve digital copies of national curricula for historical reference.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This collection is for students, parents, and educators seeking free access to Chinese educational materials. It is highly beneficial for overseas Chinese families and those in economically disadvantaged areas.
